cohort.source_roles: all independent role-family 3 seeds, carry source-selected family memory only; new DEV seeds exposed on first original step, no independent sealed holdout

mechanism.label: ENGINEERED egocentric map projection with own-selected forward-overlap evidence and empirical hypothesized frontier visits, never hidden map/pose and never independently learned semantic topology
mechanism.base_policy: Original MG47 DoorMemoryNavigation source inherited; candidate and ablation both use unchanged MG44 release target FSM and own selected door consequence memory. MG48 only changes choose in phase seek under source-public context.
mechanism.projection: Project only public image7x7 cells type nonzero into putative x/y coordinates using public direction (0 east, 1 south, 2 west, 3 north), agent visible at local(3,6). Engineered public view geometry, not hidden source coords.
mechanism.selected_forward_kinematics: On own selected action2, compare original before/after public images aligned to current public direction and hypothesized poses (same versus one step forward). Infer displacement only if translated overlap has >=8 identical nonzero cells and >=3 more exact public object-type/state matches than stationary alignment. Otherwise keep pose estimate with ambiguous-forward counter. Record no true displacement claim.
mechanism.local_frontier: At current hypothesized node, build observed traversable adjacent cells from own source-public projected cells (empty/floor/goal or open door only), and rank one-step candidate heading by front traversability, low empirical selected forward visits, nearby never-seen public-projected cells. After at least one own selected forward overlap success, prefer lowest visit heading as candidate source action 0/1/2; avoid repeating known locked door action5 without observed key evidence. Never override native MG44 target-release FSM or exact source literal visible mission target in front, and preserve original MG47 decision when no grounded overlap successes.
mechanism.new_policy_difference: After original MG47 chooses (and sets pending), if phase seek AND grounded empirical forward-success count >0 AND no exact mission target in public front, compute hypothesized adjacent visits: choose forward action2 when front passable and its estimated neighbor visit count <= minimum side direction counts; otherwise turn 0 left or 1 right toward lower-visited passable public-heading neighbor; exact tie is left. All other cases return original MG47 action. Update pending from source digest to chosen action. Does not prescribe mission-specific path.
mechanism.ablation: Same source-selected forward-overlap model and checkpoint state, but enabled=false so no action overrides; matches the original MG47 door-memory enabled source role on all corresponding original selected trajectories.
mechanism.memory: Within family three original episodes retain projected cells and candidate-visited counts; each episode reset pose (0,0), heading from public, and grounded alignment phase; reset private coordinate hypothesis, not genuine hidden pose.
mechanism.limitations: No true map frame, hidden x/y, inventory, map oracle or same-place identity. Dead-reckoning can drift. A public image match is an engineered uncertain inference, not verified real movement or causal loop closure.

metrics.primary: true first public exact mission target sighting, selected exact mission-target pickup/disappearance, genuine positive terminal rewards across 2 larger KeyCorridors and maze
metrics.secondary: source-selected actions, forward-alignment successes, ambiguous forward effects, actual source selected front-door state transitions, hypothesized coordinates/coverage only explicitly labeled, action histograms and public view repeats
metrics.control: unchanged MG47 door memory ON/OFF and MG44 release ON/OFF; unchanged MG34 graph lookahead, MG33 frontier, exact corrected UCB, and unchanged original native Wingless/Yggdrasil; no independent model-based baseline stronger than MG34 inferred
metrics.resources: per episode original selected source action count and auxiliary Python CPU/wall/child CPU, no matched full native RSS or energy claim

pass_conditions: at least one actual selected-grounded forward-alignment positive within either larger corridor family
candidate exact original public mission target sighting in one larger KeyCorridor family
candidate at least one authentic original positive terminal goal in a larger KeyCorridor family
candidate at least one actual positive goal in ObstructedMaze
candidate genuine goal total strictly exceeds each listed conventional baseline including same-model frontier-disabled
two independent full original Farama source processes identical and source-pinned, Windows/Ubuntu source-only PASS before any new world action
